title: Salon Invoice Template
subtitle: An invoice pre-filled for salon services — haircut, color, shampoo & blowout, treatment, event styling and retail products. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Payment due at time of service unless prior arrangements are agreed.
notes: Thank you for your business. Retail products carry manufacturer satisfaction guarantee.
features: Auto-calculating tax formulas in Excel (just enter your state rate)
Pre-filled salon line items: cut, color, blowout, treatment, event styling, retail
Tip-friendly total section for front-desk checkout
Pay-at-service terms keep the till simple

faqs.q: What should I include on a salon invoice?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name, the client details, a dated line-item list of services (cut, color, treatment, styling) plus any retail products, tax, and a total due. Itemize services so clients can verify their bill and rebook the same stylist package.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate tax automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, tax and total update automatically. Leave the tax rate blank if you are not required to charge sales tax.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your tax authority and a CPA or attorney before use.
